## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User impact

Explain any visible behavior change or migration consideration.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when the workflow changes

## Screenshots

Include screenshots only when they materially help review a visual change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated files.
- [ ] No credentials, databases, backups, or user data are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
